description: Maps an inbound JSON message onto a FHIR resource by hand in main.lua, using the fhir_creator helpers, and forwards the completed FHIR JSON to the next node (typically the FHIR Validator). templates/patient.json is a reference of the shape being built (from the FHIR Profile Designer); it is not parsed at runtime. The resource is constructed from populated fields only - absent, empty and JSON-null inputs are omitted - so there are no unresolved placeholders and no null-cleanup step. Edit RESOURCE_TYPE and the mapping in main.lua to build a different resource. This node prepares FHIR JSON; the FHIR Validator remains the authority on structure, version and profiles.
